### C1 -- clean FedAvg must beat the frozen checkpoint

- passed on 8/10 seeds

### H3 -- does the certified gate improve held-out quality under attack?

- the gate helped in 20/25 configurations
- the gate was the **do-nothing baseline** (gated model byte-identical to the frozen checkpoint on every seed) in 0/25 configurations

> A configuration where the gated model is byte-identical to the frozen pretrained checkpoint is NOT evidence that the gate works: it means the gate rejected every round, so the comparison only shows that federated training was net-harmful in that cell. This is audit finding F5 and it must be read together with the C1 verdict.
